note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/next_scan.py; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The scanner is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Audit the Next.js app in evals/fixtures/bad_site/app. Fix what is wrong without changing what the pages show, then give me a report of what you found and what you left.
assertions: [script] next_scan.py scan on the fixed app/ prints no finding with severity error
[script] The fixed app has no file containing 'use client' that imports from 'server-only', 'next/headers', 'node:fs' or ../../lib/db
[script] dashboard/page.tsx no longer has the possible-waterfall finding and still calls both getStats and the /me fetch
[judge] 'use client' was removed from or moved out of settings/page.tsx by extracting a small client leaf, not by deleting state logic
[judge] The report uses the fixed shape (Version, Scanner before/after, Fixed, Kept on purpose, Judgement changes, Not checked) and states the Next major was not determinable or assumed
[judge] The report does not claim runtime caching or performance was measured

evals.prompt: This Next.js 15 product page calls fetch('https://api.shop.example/products/' + id) with no options and shows the price and stock. Prices change a few times a day, stock changes on every sale and must be near-live. Tell me how to fetch and cache it, and write the code.
assertions: [judge] States that in Next 15 plain fetch is not cached by default, so caching must be opted into
[judge] Separates the slow-changing price (time-based or tag revalidation) from the near-live stock (not cached or a short Suspense-wrapped dynamic read) instead of one setting for both
[judge] Starts independent reads in parallel rather than awaiting them in sequence
[judge] Does not recommend 'use cache' or cacheComponents as a Next 15 setting without saying it applies to 16

evals.prompt: In my Next.js 15 app add SEO metadata for app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (title from the post, canonical, no indexing of ?page= duplicates) and add a Stripe-style webhook at app/api/hooks/route.ts. Posts come from a database via getPost(slug).
assertions: [script] The webhook code reads the body with request.text() or arrayBuffer before JSON.parse
[judge] getPost is wrapped in React cache() so generateMetadata and the page share one query
[judge] The handler verifies the signature before acting and does not use a Server Action for the webhook
[judge] Says what was not run or verified (no build was executed)
